initiative.title: Change chart settings where the data is
initiative.summary: Make frequent chart changes local and clear while keeping ordinary click-to-filter primary.
initiative.next_action: Review the implementation plan, then start Milestone 1 (scatter point click proof) if approved.

claims.statement: Make frequent chart changes close to the feature being edited.
Ground the proposal in verified mechanics from other visualization tools.
Compare a wide range of interaction approaches and chart settings.
Give ordinary click-to-filter priority over other gesture claims.
Allow Alt-click and tracing access to be redesigned.
claims.notes: Trace is rare; it exists to force a planning/rendering split. Its gesture may move to the header and a record action.

claims.statement: Right-click a scatter point and choose Color by to pick a field.
Treat frequency rankings as hypotheses because no telemetry was supplied.
Cover every frequently changed property — Color, X, Y, and plotted fields — through one editable-role pattern.
claims.notes: Scatter Color is the first case, not the whole scope.

claims.statement: Choosing a value applies at once; Cmd/Ctrl-Z undoes it as one step.
claims.notes: Live preview while browsing is worth trying (Answer 4).

claims.statement: A field uses one shared color scale by default; separate tuned copies come later.
The first audience is Byron in the demo; host opt-in waits.

conflicts.description: Repository docs reserve Alt-click for tracing. The latest user direction explicitly allows that binding to change.
conflicts.resolution: Treat the binding as current behavior, not a proposed-design invariant. Preserve click-to-filter as the stronger constraint. Product answers confirm trace is rare and may move to the header and a record action.

options.premise: One existing editor with exact contextual navigation
Named object actions choose a local task
Visible encoding roles serve as the control surface
Chart geometry directly represents editable values
A deliberate object toolbar groups repeated edits
An explicit mode changes gesture ownership

brainstorm.selected_option: Build option-3 as an editable-role pattern with option-2 as a second entry; one design adjusted through use. Retain option-4 and the option-1 fallback.

shape.appetite: Scatter Color as a reusable editable role, then X and Y. Research and docs only in this run.
shape.problem: Repeated chart changes require navigation away from the question. Hidden configuration can also conflict with filtering.
shape.recommended_shape: Visible role labels plus a plot context menu opening one field editor; instant apply with one-step undo; trace moves off Alt-click.

success_moves.move: Build one design and adjust through use instead of switchable variants.
Resolve chart scope without requiring exact record identity.
success_moves.effect: Dense overlapping points do not block chart configuration.

success_moves.move: Apply on choice and group scale creation with binding into one host change.
success_moves.effect: One Cmd/Ctrl-Z restores the chart and any scale the choice created.

success_moves.move: Reuse field metadata, scale resolution, and updateChart through a small popup presentation seam.
success_moves.effect: No generic command or transaction platform is required.

success_moves.move: Keep filtering immediate; verify input, focus, and scope before broader adoption.
Include docs and examples in every proposed visible slice.
success_moves.effect: Gesture changes remain discoverable and reviewable.

first_proof.question: Does an editable Color role, reached from a visible label and a context menu, make shaping a new chart faster without touching filters?
first_proof.artifact: Future dense-chart-controls demo; not produced in this research run.
first_proof.try: Verify unsized point selection first. Filtered scatter points/bubbles, a shared-scale peer, no legend, categorical/numeric/computed fields, instant apply, one-step undo, preview while browsing, keyboard, and trace through its new routes.
first_proof.observe: Filters and peer unchanged, one undo step per choice, focus return, which entry gets used in real demo work.
first_proof.decision_rule: Reject filter or scope regressions and anything needing more than one undo. Drop the menu if the label covers real use. Keep preview only if it leaves no history.
first_proof.first_dependency_role: Real local React UI and store with synthetic rows; no remote provider.
first_proof.fallback: Keep existing settings; the visible label alone may satisfy the outcome.

rabbit_holes: Generic chart conversion or X/Y swap

open_decisions.question: What should Alt/Option-click do once trace moves?
open_decisions.resolution: Decide during use; no new meaning is required for the first proof.

open_decisions.question: Do role labels stay visible or reveal on focus?
open_decisions.resolution: Decide during use, keeping a touch-visible route.

milestones.title: Ordinary scatter point clicks select
milestones.outcome: A plain click on any scatter point selects it and an empty-space click clears, sized or unsized.
milestones.proof: ScatterSvg.test.tsx pointer sequence on an unsized point; manual mouse check in the demo.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: No new UI; existing behavior guarded or fixed.
milestones.rollback: Revert the fix; the test documents the gap.

milestones.title: A visible Color label changes the field in place
milestones.outcome: On a scatter, the Color label opens field search, applies a choice at once, and one Cmd/Ctrl-Z restores it with any new scale.
milestones.proof: Vitest for one host notification, unchanged filters, undo removing a created scale, shared-scale peer; pnpm shot at 1280/783/390.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Settings panel route unchanged; label is an extra route on scatter only.
milestones.rollback: Remove ChartRoleControl from the scatter definition; saved layouts unaffected.

milestones.title: Right-click the plot to color or trace
milestones.outcome: A scatter plot context menu offers Color by…, Trace this record, and image export, with keyboard parity.
milestones.proof: Tests for menu order (axis/title first, Shift native), dismissal not filtering, trace target resolution; demo check.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Alt-click trace still works; the menu adds routes only.

milestones.title: Preview fields while browsing
milestones.outcome: Arrowing through fields recolors live; Escape restores; history and scales show only the final choice.
milestones.proof: Vitest for browse+Escape and browse+choose leaving clean history and scale list; responsiveness on the largest demo dataset.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Instant apply from m2 works with or without preview.

milestones.title: Change X and Y the same way
milestones.outcome: X and Y fields change through the same role editor from the axis title, each as one undo step.
milestones.proof: Tests for axis title Enter and menu entry, range/log reset in one step, existing axis gestures unchanged; pnpm shot.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Color role from m2 unaffected; settings panel still edits X and Y.
milestones.rollback: Remove the Change field… entry and Enter binding.

history.event: Initialized from the user request and correction. Submitted research to Pro power 5 of 5; scheduled collection.
Collected complete Pro output. Verified primary mechanics and all supplied source identities. Reconciled recommendations into intent, seven options, and shape. Implementation remains unrequested.
Incorporated ten product answers: all properties in scope, instant apply with undo, shared scale per field, trace may move, demo audience, single design instead of variant comparison.
Wrote a five-milestone implementation plan: click proof, Color label with instant apply and undo, plot context menu with trace, preview, X/Y roles.
